decision.title: Record matching, optional fields and map:keys-where follow the 2026-10-20 drafts (packet fix-1)

body.p: , after , . The book packets reported three bugs: { } instance of record(*) and {"a": 1} instance of record(a) are false (treat as raises XPDY0050), record(a, b?) and b? as xs:boolean are XPST0003, and map:keys-where is XPST0017. All three are what the editor's drafts of 2026-10-20 and the pinned QT4 suite say, so the library keeps them; later packets do not reopen them.

item.p: Matching (XPath 4.0, 3.2.10.1): "A record R matches a structural record type T" when R has an entry of the field's type for every field and as many entries as T has fields; record(*) "matches any record: that is, any map with a type annotation identifying it as a record". A plain map is no record; coercion (3.4.2: let $x as record(...), arguments, results, xsl:variable as) makes one, filling emptiable fields. So instance of, treat as and typeswitch need a value that was coerced; RecordType-001a, -105 and -106 assert false for plain maps.

No optional or extensible fields: FieldDeclaration ::= FieldName ("as" SequenceType)?; a field whose type allows the empty sequence may be absent before coercion. RecordType-007 and -012 to -014 expect XPST0003.
No map:keys-where: F&O 4.0, 14.4 lists no such function, and map:keys takes only the map; no QT4 or XT40 case names it.
XT40's record set lags: record-003 and -005 (changed 2026-04, before PR 2566) coerce a three-field record to a two-field type, which QT4's RecordType-016 (2026-07) makes XPTY0004; they stay failed.

Measured (release, HEAD 6ed649a, no library change): QT4 XP40/XQ40 prod-RecordType 17/23 (6 not run) and 23/23, ButWithExpr 26/26, NamedRecordTypeDecl -/90 (the 4 failures are the module-path cases of ), CastExpr.composite and CastableExpr.composite 67/67, misc-Subtyping -/118 (41 not run); XT40 record 40/47, unchanged. Tests pin it: evaluator_test record_types_match_records, xquery_test typeswitch-record, FunctionDecl-record and map-keys-where, three syntax cases in xpath_static_test.
